request.body:
## Result and scope

Refs #56

- Claim comment URL and session: https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/issues/56#issuecomment-6867384549, session `ADB991-claude-20261113-46a7`
- Outputs: report-only, new files in `blueprint/units/YM-000026/handoff/results/C15/review/ADB991-claude-20261113-46a7/` (`README.md`, `mathematics.md`, `lean-correspondence.md`, `validation.md`, `inspected-sha256.txt`). No manuscript, author record or `Lean/` change.
- Human contributors and agent assistance: prepared by Claude (Anthropic), one session, no subagents.

Prepared autonomously by Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent on behalf of @ADB991; ADB991 had not reviewed it before submission.

This is an independent review, covering mathematics and textual Lean correspondence, of three C15 chapters from schmittj's author pass #105 that #107 and #112 did not cover: `trace-small-means.tex`, `trace-crown-buffer.tex` and `trace-price-recurrence.tex`, at `codex/existence-monograph` @ `13f52dd`.

**Verdict.** Under their stated inputs, all three chapters prove what they state. Every inequality and exponent was recomputed. The statements match `YM.Trace.Terrace.small_means`, `YM.Trace.Terrace.stageCrown` and `YM.PhysicalNext.Repeat.Quince.ascend` in hypotheses, constants and quantifier order. Author repairs E1–E3, E11 and G1–G3 are confirmed.

- **M1 (required, minor), crown-buffer.** Two steps have no proof or citation: the "translated form" of the tiled-product inequality in `lem:ex-trace-crown-good`, and the claim that the seam condition holds for every β ≥ 0. The producers already exist: `prop:ex-centered-planted` (`eq:ex-centered-seam-planted`) and `prop:ex-lattice-finite-reflection`. What is missing is a short translate-to-copy step: each translate is the prescribed copy of an oriented, possibly conjugated chamber-interior field with the same root (source: `pulpit` → `rooted_translates` → `source_for_translate`).
- **S1 (should), price-recurrence.** The polarization estimate that defines `M_d` is asserted without proof (source: `Cub.speedTest`). The proposition takes the one-step estimate as a hypothesis, so it is not affected.
- N1–N7 (wording and notation) and O1–O4 (optional) are listed in `README.md`.

**Independence caveat.** ADB991's earlier commit `a4a73dc9` (#194, source-leakage wording) touched these files. mgubi's leakage review already covers those hunks, and this report does not certify them.

## Evidence

- Pinned source revision: `3456e5e75cf8d4cd558955a5c7638fba2d68f464`. Every inspected source file's hash matches `Lean/SOURCES.sha256`.
- Commands actually run and results:
  - `python3 scripts/check_blueprint.py`: Blueprint structure OK, 4 units.
  - `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`: 22 tests OK.
  - `git diff --check`: clean.
  - `sha256sum` on all inspected files.
- Checks not performed and why:
  - No LaTeX build, because no `.tex` file changed.
  - No Lean elaboration or `#print axioms`; the source was read as text.
  - The chapters' outstanding inputs were not checked: Crown witness, transfer and one-site receipts, paid direction, insertion estimate, detector inputs, mission price.
- Dependency/interface changes and affected units: none.

## Review and handoff

- [x] The scope matches the task and has no duplicate declaration ownership.
- [x] Source citations and hypotheses have been checked, where applicable.
- [x] Applicable literature results were sought; substantive steps have detailed proofs or verified references. (The findings list the unproved steps; no external literature was consulted, and O4's locator is from memory.)
- [x] Structural checks pass.
- [x] Draft/reviewed status is accurate; stale reviews were cleared or renewed. (No status is changed.)
- [x] The issue has a handoff and links to any durable Bots notes. (Handoff on #56; no Bots note.)

Required next review: author response to M1/S1 (schmittj or another account), then a renewed check by an account other than ADB991; human acceptance.
